title: Is it safe to use a USB-C laptop charger on your phone? - Engadget
summary: Charging results can vary depending on the charger, cable, phone model and charging protocol involved. It's still generally fine because a USB-PD charger connected to a non-USB-PD phone will simply default to a safe output.
